messagepanel.consequence: Contact with live parts can cause electric shock.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Disconnect the power cable from the wall outlet before you open the fuse holder.

prereq.p: Set the power switch to OFF.
Disconnect the power cable from the wall outlet.

step.cmd: Unscrew the fuse holder cap with a flat-blade screwdriver.
Remove the blown fuse from the cap.

messagepanel.consequence: A fuse with a higher rating does not protect the radio and can cause overheating.
messagepanel.howtoavoid: Replace the fuse only with a fuse of the same type and rating.

step.cmd: Put new fuse (500 mA) in the place of old one.
Screw the fuse holder cap back in.
